title: FLA import: CPicSwf class not supported — embedded SWF symbols (Claw.swft, claw2.swft) silently dropped
description:
Loading Magnet.fla logs 4 warnings:

  [FLA import] class "CPicSwf" is not supported; skipping its data (flash8-binary.ts:245)

Magnet.fla contains two symbols named 'Claw.swft' and 'claw2.swft' which appear to be embedded SWF assets (CPicSwf records). These are silently skipped during import. In the library they show as Movie Clips with 0 use count, suggesting their content was not decoded.

Expected: CPicSwf records should be parsed and imported as SWF-sourced symbols, or at minimum flagged to the user that these symbols are unsupported and will be empty.
